summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of the Enterprise Query Assistant (KnowledgeCenter.jsx refactor, iteration_177 successor). Executed 24 Playwright scenarios covering: autocomplete for 'art' (6 artifact buttons), 'artifact:' (all 6 types with live counts DOCUMENT=276 / others=0), 'artifact:D' filtered prefix match, 'status:' (4 statuses with counts: Active=60, Review=197, Draft=18, Archived=1), 'category:' (all 20 categories with doc counts), 'category:Arch' substring filter (→ Architecture only), group headers (kc-sug-group-Artifact-Type/Status/Category), keyboard nav (ArrowDown/ArrowUp with wrap), Enter accepts + closes + focuses input at end-of-insertion, Tab has same behavior as Enter, Escape closes without clearing input, mouse click accepts (onMouseDown), click-outside on kc-title closes dropdown, placeholder is 'Search documents...', help panel with 3 clickable examples (artifact-DOCUMENT, status-ACTIVE, category-Architecture), combined queries (artifact:DOCUMENT audit → 50 rezultate + artifact chip, status:ACTIVE → 60 rezultate + status chip, artifact:DOCUMENT status:ACTIVE → 60 + both chips, artifact:DOCUMENT category:Architecture audit → 2 + all 3 chips), empty-state (artifact:REGISTRY → 'No Registry artifacts found.' + 'Infrastructure ready.' + kc-suggest-DOCUMENT), clicking kc-suggest-DOCUMENT fills 'artifact:DOCUMENT', regression plain 'sprint' (50 results, no chips), regression artifact filter pills, regression tab navigation (Documente/Dependency Map/Review). PERFORMANCE: verified ZERO /api/founder/knowledge/search calls during typing (0 requests while typing 'artifact:DOCUMENT'), exactly 1 API call per submit. ALL 24 SCENARIOS PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: KnowledgeCenter.jsx is now 738 lines — has crossed the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting SearchPanel (~180 lines: form, suggestions dropdown, help panel, results block, empty-state) and ReviewPane/InspectorPane into their own files in a future refactor pass.
Escape key handling (line 498) is scoped inside onKeyDown; correctly does e.preventDefault() and does NOT clear input — verified.
onMouseDown handler (line 533) uses e.preventDefault() to avoid blur-before-click race — works as intended across all suggestion types.
Suggestions useMemo depends on [q, caret, tree, artifactContract] — no unnecessary recomputation. Zero network hits during typing was empirically confirmed.
TOKEN_REGEX(op) is created fresh in doSearch and again in display-strip loop; minor micro-optimization would be to cache per-op regex but not a real perf concern for KC-scale usage.

Category matching (matchesCategory) uses strict equality (===) case-insensitive, while the autocomplete category filter uses .includes(val) — small semantic asymmetry: user could type category:Arch in autocomplete, get 'Architecture', but if they typed 'category:Arch' manually and submitted, applyClientFilters would NOT match 'Architecture'. Not a bug per spec (autocomplete inserts full name), but worth noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_178 fully validated the Enterprise Query Assistant refactor. Live counts at test time: artifact_type_counts={DOCUMENT:276, others:0}, status_counts={Active:60, Review:197, Draft:18, Archived:1}, 20 categories including 'Architecture' (9 docs). All autocomplete/keyboard/mouse/click-outside/combined-query/empty-state/regression scenarios green. Zero-request typing confirmed (autocomplete is 100% client-side). Only remaining note is file size: KnowledgeCenter.jsx=738 lines, past 700-line split threshold — flagged for future refactor, not blocking.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature test, not bug RCA. Feature works as specified end-to-end.
